root_cause.text: Marking the `swap_space` address space structure as read-only (`__ro_after_init`) causes a kernel panic due to a write-permission violation when the kernel attempts to record a writeback error via `__filemap_set_wb_err` if `arch_prepare_to_swap` fails.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff reverts the definition of `swap_space` from `__ro_after_init` to `__read_mostly` in `mm/swap.h` and `mm/swap_state.c`, and the CVE description shows a kernel panic (`el1_abort`) triggered by `errseq_set` and `__filemap_set_wb_err` during page reclaim (`shrink_folio_list`).
